title: Report of the Secretary-General on the activities of the United Nations Regional Office for Central Africa (S/2025/772)
organization: United Nations Secretary-General / United Nations Office for Central Africa
temporal_coverage: Regional climate conditions in June–August 2025 and a reported Namibe incident on 17 August 2025.
methodology: UN Secretary-General's regional political and humanitarian reporting, including climate-service information.
limitations: The report gives no independent causal assessment or names for the communities involved.

title: Nationally Determined Contribution of Angola 2025 (NDC 3.0)
organization: Republic of Angola, Ministry of Environment
temporal_coverage: National climate assessments and adaptation priorities, with historical examples and plans through 2035.
methodology: NDC reviews national climate and sector plans.
limitations: Commitments are not independently evaluated outcomes.

title: Eastern and Southern Africa Region Humanitarian Situation Report No. 2, 1 January–31 December 2024
organization: UNICEF Eastern and Southern Africa Regional Office
temporal_coverage: Regional and Angola situation and response reporting for calendar year 2024, with some cited water-point data from 2022.
methodology: Regional UNICEF situation report aggregates country-office needs and response reporting.
limitations: Some water-point estimates are dated; the report gives limited local disaggregation.

title: Angola Preparedness for Resilient Recovery Project: First Project Report
temporal_coverage: Project progress and disaster-preparedness activities reported for September 2014–September 2015.
methodology: UNDP project progress report records preparedness, training and recovery-assessment activities.
limitations: It is a first-year report; many subsequent provincial and municipal plans were targets, not verified results.

title: Angola Food Security Outlook, June 2026–January 2027: Likely El Niño-induced dryness to lead to outcomes aligned with Crisis in southern areas by November
temporal_coverage: Current food-security conditions through June 2026 and outlook through January 2027.
methodology: FEWS NET synthesizes weather, crop, market, livelihood and nutrition evidence.
limitations: Not a census; some nutrition surveillance is not representative.
